name: io.github.sathya-sankaran/yellide
title: yellide
description: Species of India by kingdom, group, state, district, region or threat, with Kew native-range flags.

tools.name: find_species
tools.description: Find species of India by Latin name or English common name (any word of it, from its start: "great indian bustard", "naja", "cobra"). Returns up to 10 species with their key for get_species, group, IUCN category and status.

name.description: A Latin or English name, or its start.

tools.name: get_species
tools.description: One species of India by its key (from find_species or list_species): sources that list it, open record, states with an open record, WII regions, IUCN category with the year, DOI and trend of the assessment, endemic and the sources that mark it endemic (endemic_marked_by; null in a list built before 26 Nov 2026), year described and authority, family and order, evidence (type specimens, photos, DNA barcodes), names in Indian languages, a photo with its credit, and iNaturalist observations that wait for a name.

tools.name: count_species
tools.description: How many species of India: documented, with an open record, threatened (IUCN CR, EN, VU), recorded in the last 10 years, endemic, per IUCN category and per kingdom (by_kingdom: animals, plants, fungi, other). For a state or district, threatened and endemic count only species with a dated record there in the last 10 years and no not-native flag (quote these); threatened_all_time and endemic_all_time count all, undated_only the species with no dated record there, not_native the species Kew does not give as native there or GRIIS India lists as introduced, and not_wild those the record keepers mark as planted, kept or introduced. All filters are optional and combine: "how many butterflies in India", "threatened birds in Kerala", "endemic frogs of the Western Ghats", "plants of Shivamogga" (kingdom: plants).

group.description: A group of the list, or a word of it: "Birds", "butterflies", "mammals" (all mammal groups), "orchids"; "animals" and "plants" mean the kingdom. See yellide://groups.

kingdom.description: animals, plants (with mosses and liverworts), fungi (with lichens) or other (algae, diatoms and the rest). See yellide://groups.

state.description: A state or union territory of India: "Karnataka". See yellide://states.

district.description: A district (LGD): its name, "Wayanad", or its LGD code; or a list of districts for an area that is made of districts (the Mahanadi delta: ["Cuttack", "Jagatsinghapur", "Kendrapara", "Puri"]), where each species counts once. Give the state too when two states have the name. See yellide://districts.

region.description: A WII biogeographic zone ("Western Ghats", "Himalaya", "North-East", "Islands"), a province ("Western Ghats: Mountains") or a province code ("5B"). See yellide://regions.

iucn.description: IUCN Red List categories: CR, EN, VU, NT, LC, DD, NE (not assessed), or "threatened" (CR, EN, VU).

endemic.description: true: only species a source marks as endemic to India; false: only species not marked. Some groups have no marks yet (the answer names them).

open_record.description: true: species with an open record from India; false: species known only from checklists and papers.

recorded_since.description: Species with an open record placed in India in this year or later; with a state, placed in the state; with a district, a GBIF record placed in the district.

described_since.description: Species described in this year or later.

counted.description: With a state or a district: true gives only the species that count_species' headline threatened and endemic counts count there (a dated record there in the last 10 years and no not-native flag); with iucn: ["threatened"] it lists exactly the headline threatened species. false: the others.

tools.name: list_species
tools.description: List species of India with optional filters that combine: "critically endangered species in India", "endangered animals in Karnataka" (kingdom: animals), "snakes of the Western Ghats", "birds of Goa recorded since 2020". For a state or a district the list keeps every species with a record there, old and undated ones too (in_district or in_state gives the latest year there; counted says if count_species' headline threatened and endemic counts count it, not_counted why not; pass counted: true for exactly that set, recorded_since for recent records); kew_not_native: true marks a plant Kew does not give as native there, introduced_in_india: true a species GRIIS India lists; not_wild counts the species the record keepers mark as planted, kept or introduced. Rows by group, then Latin name; up to 100 per page, with the total and a cursor for the next page.

tools.name: new_species
tools.description: Species described from India since a year (2007 or later), from Plazi, the BSI Plant Discoveries and the ZSI Animal Discoveries: the year, the group, the state of the type locality, the journal and a link to the paper, and whether it has been recorded since. "new species discovered in India 2025", "new frog species from India".

since.description: Described in this year or later (2007 or later).

group.description: A group of the list, or a word of it: "Birds", "butterflies", "mammals" (all mammal groups), "orchids"; "animals" and "plants" mean the kingdom. See yellide://groups.

state.description: The state of the type locality.
